body:
> From the review of PR #160 (#153, merged 2026-08-28). The guard exemption, the worktree-on-PR-branch and the continuation brief are correct and tested; these are the gaps the review found, none of which blocked the merge.

## What

1. **Fast-forward the continued branch** (`src/board.js` ~246, `worktreeOnBranch`): `git worktree add <dir> <branch>` reuses the *local* branch as-is; the fetch updates `origin/<branch>` but nothing fast-forwards. Reproduced: one commit pushed to the PR branch by a human → the continuation checkout is one behind and its plain `git push` is rejected non-fast-forward, contradicting the brief ("an ordinary `git push` updates the PR"). After the add, `git -C <dir> merge --ff-only origin/<branch>` (best effort); if the local branch cannot fast-forward, fall back to the recipe block and say why in the attempt row.
2. **Skip the checkout for trigger-mode profiles** (`src/dispatch.js` ~108): for `claude-action` the Actions dispatcher creates the worktree in its own ephemeral checkout, records `continues_branch` and logs "continuing PR on <branch>", while the real worker runs elsewhere on a fresh `actions/checkout` — the run record lies by protocol.md's own definition. `profile.mode === 'trigger'` → no worktree, `continues_pr` only.
3. **The reviewer's note reaches the worker whole.** `src/lifecycle.js` ~345 slices the reason to 400 chars on the attempt row, and `src/context.js` ~8 filters the `**Changes requested**` comment out of the brief's Comments section — so a relaunched worker sees the review cut mid-sentence (live #146: items 2 and 3 of its review never reach the brief). Either stop truncating the reviewer row, or render the full comment inside the continuation block. Test with a 1,500-char reason.
4. **Wiki**: `features/web-board.md` went stale (5 → 6) from #160's own `src/board.js` edit; re-stamp (`node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs`).
5. Nits: `activePrGuard` picks the first OPEN PR — with two, prefer the one the last `review_requested`/`completed` row recorded; `src/cli.js` ~418 "waiting on the PR it continued, PR #147" reads awkwardly; `hkb claim --spawn` (`src/cli.js` ~473) does not pass `continuePr`, so the row lacks `continues_pr` and `finish` will not say "continued"; an exempt card waiting for a slot pays one `loadRun` per tick because the budget check comes after the guard.

## Done when

- A continuation checkout is at the PR branch's remote head even when a human pushed to it since the last attempt; its plain `git push` succeeds (fake-git test).
- A trigger-mode claim on a sent-back card records `continues_pr` and no `continues_branch`, and creates no worktree.
- A 1,500-character review reaches `hkb context <n>` in full.
- `npm run lint && npm test` green; wiki-check back to the 5-page baseline or better.

## Contract

- Never `git push --force`; a branch that cannot fast-forward is reported, not forced.
- Keep the guard predicate pure and keyed on the synthetic reviewer row only.
goal: A relaunched attempt starts on the PR branch at its remote head, trigger-mode claims record only continues_pr, and the full reviewer note is in the brief
title: Continuation attempts: fast-forward the PR branch, skip the checkout in trigger mode, hand the worker the whole review
